campaign.title: Actual-symbol double-far shifted-divisor fork

resource_policy.literature_policy: Do not import a shifted-convolution, spectral, delta-method, or large-sieve theorem by analogy. This round first derives the exact finite correlation and tests its actual-symbol main term. Any external theorem mentioned must be a primary source with every conductor, weight, shift, norm, and uniformity hypothesis matched.

frozen_target.question: For the exact Round-114 double-far survivor, can the literal chi_4-twisted shifted-divisor coefficient be exposed and estimated by a genuinely noninvertible dispersion mechanism with one factor L of saving, or does its actual-symbol main term rigorously retain equal capacity and close this route?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For one persistent j=1 block, a_B^<(h,k)=chi_4(h) eta(gcd(h,k)/(sqrt L/2)) A_B(h,k) and E_(B,df)=sum_(|r|>L)sum_n e(R(sqrt n-sqrt(n+r))) C_B(n,r), where C_B(n,r)=sum_(hk=n,h'k'=n+r, |hk'-h'k|>L) a_B^<(h,k) conjugate(a_B^<(h',k')). The target is |E_(B,df)|<<L^3 X^epsilon at R=sqrt X asymp L^3 and K asymp L. The phase is constant within a fixed (n,r) fibre, so the required saving must act on the literal signed divisor correlation or on its outer shifted-product sum.
quantities: X>=4096 real, R=sqrt X, persistent j=1, L asymp R^(1/3), and 1<=K/L<=16
one fixed physical block B with the exact Round-113 real slanted symbol A_B and all floors, tapers, profiles, stars, and support crossings
low-gcd weight eta(gcd(h,k)/(sqrt L/2)); high gcd, squares, near squares, transform error, and isolated exact-square j=2 retain prior owners
full products n=hk and n+r=h'k'; determinant rho=hk'-h'k; only |r|>L and |rho|>L remain
chi_4(h)chi_4(h') and the exact parity relation for p=h'-h must remain visible
linear target L^(3/2), energy target L^3, and coefficient-blind double-far capacity L^4
no absolute value may enter the inner divisor sum or the outer r,n sum unless the resulting capacity is explicitly paid
distinct physical blocks and gcd shells may not be combined before their accepted one-count maps

completion_criteria: Derive coefficientwise the exact divisor-pair formula for C_B(n,r), including the determinant inequality after substituting k=n/h and k'=(n+r)/h'.
Derive an exact alternative chart in increments p=h'-h and q=k'-k, including chi_4(h)chi_4(h+p), r, rho, support, and fibre multiplicities.
Identify and compute every zero-frequency or nonoscillatory main term produced by any dispersion, Poisson, delta, Mellin, or spectral decomposition before estimating a remainder.
Prove the target, a target-safe strict subrange with a smaller named survivor, a genuine positive-power saving, or an actual-symbol equal-capacity obstruction with a lawful control.
Distinguish cancellation in the inner divisor coefficient from cancellation of the outer nonlinear phase; do not transfer one to the other without an exact inequality.
Audit shift uniformity up to |r| comparable to L^2, conductor four, gcd truncation, slanted nonseparable weights, endpoint owners, and the critical R asymp L^3 relation.
Do not claim BAL, any M2 parent, M9-M1, endpoint uniformity, M9, or a new exponent unless the corresponding complete estimate and graph implication are proved.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact divisor-pair and increment charts for the supplied double-far energy, classify the character and zero-frequency structure, and determine the first lawful place where one factor L might be saved or where equal capacity persists.
excluded_context: the Round-115 derivation packet and conductor candidate
all Round-114 reports and Round-115 sibling reports
required_output: Two exact finite charts with all signs, support, and gates, or the first failed seam.
A capacity table for zero modes, generic modes, and boundary modes.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Starting only from the exact Round-114 survivor, construct and test the smallest noninvertible actual-symbol dispersion, Poisson, Mellin, or shifted-convolution inequality. Compute its main term first and prove a target-safe shift range, strict saving, full target, or exact failed seam.
required_output: An exact noninvertible transform or inequality with every main term and norm displayed.
The best proved target-safe range, saving, obstruction, or first failed seam.

tasks.target: Hostilely determine whether the literal chi_4 and slanted symbol annihilate the relevant zero-frequency/main term or whether a coherent actual-symbol contribution survives. Audit any proposed shifted-divisor or spectral theorem at the exact conductor, shift range, and norm, and isolate the smallest surviving target.
required_output: A pass/fail table for character, main-term, capacity, source, owner, and downstream seams.
An actual-symbol coherent control or a proof that the candidate main term vanishes.
The smallest lawful surviving target and state recommendation.

review_seams.requirement: The divisor-pair and increment charts agree coefficientwise with the Round-114 energy and double-far gates.
The conductor-four character and parity are retained through every main-term and transform calculation.
Every zero mode is computed before a remainder estimate is invoked.
Inner signed correlation, outer nonlinear cancellation, mean square, and absolute mass are not conflated.
Every transform, Cauchy step, shift sum, conductor, and boundary term is costed against L^3 at R asymp L^3.
Any external theorem has a primary-source card and exact hypothesis match; structural analogy has no proof status.
The two removed corridors and all prior physical owners are neither reintroduced nor double counted.
A subrange, stronger norm, or mechanism obstruction is not reported as BAL or a downstream theorem.
